JSON mode: jq -e '.untracked_count, .untracked_paths, (.scripts[0]|has("tracked"))' on --root . succeeds (0, [], true) -- 0/[] because the only untracked file is a .md, not a .sh candidate, which is correct since JSON mode is scoped to sh candidates only.
jq . on --root . output parses cleanly with stderr not redirected.

Degenerate root (/tmp/<empty-dir> with a .git dir, no agent-system/): JSON carries untracked_count:0/untracked_paths:[]; --size-line emits scripts=0 lines=0 test_suites=0 test_lines=0 md_files=0 md_lines=0 untracked=0.
